rear_service_door.architecture: dedicated main-cabinet rear service door; open from behind the pinball and pull the PC shelf rearward out of the cabinet
rear_service_door.hinge: continuous/piano hinge or equivalent compact full-height hinge
rear_service_door.latch: keyed or tool-controlled quarter-turn/compression latch; exact hardware TBD
rear_service_door.fixed_frame: compact steel-angle or equivalent rear-panel reinforcement around aperture; exact section TBD after fabrication consultation
rear_service_door.rule: rear PC service must not require opening/removing the playfield for routine RAM/GPU/SSD/cable service

pc_slide.architecture: small flat plywood shelf approximately matching the open-case footprint; shelf and bolted open case pull straight out through the rear service door
pc_slide.slide_pair: simple 300 mm-class full-extension ball-bearing slides or equivalent telescopic rails; exact pair selected locally
pc_slide.side_spacer_rail_material: compact plywood/aluminum spacer rail; final stack follows measured slide thickness
pc_slide.stowed_retention_concept: one simple captive thumb screw, spring pin or equivalent positive stop accessible after opening the rear door
pc_slide.case_mounting: open PC case bolts directly to the flat shelf; no second sled or drawer box
pc_slide.case_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual open PC case is purchased and measured
pc_slide.slide_mounting_holes_status: BLOCKED until actual slide pair is purchased and measured
pc_slide.service_access: from behind machine: isolate cabinet power, open rear service door, release shelf retainer, pull shelf 300 mm rearward, service PC while it is outside the cabinet
pc_slide.complete_removal: use slide disconnect if supplied or release the measured rail hardware, then remove shelf + bolted case from the rear
pc_slide.cable_policy: PC harnesses have a protected rearward service loop for full travel; routine service does not require opening the playfield
pc_slide.rule: keep PC service intentionally literal and simple: rear door + small board + short slide pair + open case bolted directly to board
